blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Eastern sections of the Visayas and Mindanao will continue to experience cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms on Thursday, September 24, due to the trough, or extension, of a tropical storm outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
